description: This file implements a custom version of the getopt() function for parsing command line options, including support for Unicode on Windows. It also defines a method Options::Parse() that utilizes getopt() to process command line arguments within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: A class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace that provides command line argument parsing functionality.

methods.name: Options::Parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments using the custom getopt() implementation and sets internal command state.
